_doc: Relay targets for the voice `relay(target, text)` tool. The model may ONLY name a target defined here — never a raw command or URL — so this file is the entire trust boundary. kind=cli runs cmd+args with the text on stdin (no shell, no interpolation); kind=api POSTs {<field>: text} to url. Add your own; keep it to things you'd let a voice command trigger.

note.desc: append the text as a note to /tmp/relay-notes.txt

say.desc: speak the text aloud via the macOS say command
